name: Brandon L. Abshier
tagline: Top rated General Litigation attorney in Columbus, Ohio
about: Brandon L. Abshier is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Columbus, Ohio area. Providing legal representation in Ohio for a variety of different issues, Brandon Abshier was selected to Rising Stars for 2014 - 2021.

After completing undergraduate studies, Brandon L. Abshier attended law school. Brandon Abshier was enrolled at Capital University Law School. He earned a juris doctor degree in 2008. Brandon Abshier was admitted to the practice of law in 2008.

Attorneys like Brandon L. Abshier are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Brandon Abshier represents clients with General Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Workers' Compensation: Employer / Insurance and Construction Litigation: Business.
